measurement_context: Normal desktop session, no competing model runs from this experiment; other desktop applications were not closed. No system-wide cold-cache reset. Not a hardware-isolated performance test.
quality_review: Sources and outputs read by Codex. Subjective, not blinded, not independently human-validated. No second inference model used as judge.
storage: Weights, Python environment and caches are ignored under output/reformulation/. Only scripts, corpus, manifests, results and report are versioned.
network: Downloads of public model assets only. Generation used local files and loopback HTTP for Qwen; no corpus text sent to a remote inference service.
